timestamp_sources.server_first_push: GitHub repository activity API (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/activity, retrieved 2026-11-17T02:03:09Z; an earlier retrieval the same day listed the same events): the earliest push, force-push, branch-creation or PR-merge event whose pushed head contains the commit (ancestry checked with git merge-base). Server clock. The feed does not list tag creations, so a commit could have reached the server earlier under a tag; the time given is an upper bound on first receipt.
timestamp_sources.events_api_corroboration: GitHub events API (lossy feed); a matching event on the same ref within 5 s, where the feed has one.
timestamp_sources.runs: GitHub Actions API (GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{id}): created_at and run_started_at are server-side.
timestamp_sources.author_date: git author date (set by the client, not by the server).

redaction_round_2.changes: Personal rows are listed in REDACTION_LOG.md under 'Round 2'. Timestamps that carried a local UTC offset, here and in the released text, are written as the same instant in UTC. The contact address is removed from the creator record. No scientific content, number, rule or JSONL record changed.

redaction_round_3.scope: Third pass for indirect and inferential identifiers: calendar dates that followed the local time zone, session/message/request identifiers, CI run ids, commit SHAs and branch names, spending, plan and usage-habit details, role wording about the author, names of private harness scripts and files, provider-account artefacts, free text inside the JSONL records, and file metadata.
redaction_round_3.changes: Rows are listed in REDACTION_LOG.md under 'Round 3'. Dates that followed the local calendar are written as UTC dates; role wording about the owner reads 'the author'; private harness script and file names are markers; self-hosted model wording is neutral. In this manifest, one timestamp-source note no longer uses local time-of-day wording. No scientific content, number, rule, figure value or JSONL record changed.
redaction_round_3.not_found: No session, conversation, message or request identifier (UUID or provider id) and no provider project or organisation id occurs in any file; every JSONL timestamp is UTC.
